verdict.rationale: Mesh's case management lets analysts review alerts and record a case decision such as 'no risk detected', which covers resolving a false positive. Cases and alerts can be remediated in the web app or via the API. Nothing in the evidence shows reopening or overriding a prior decision, or an audit record of decision changes. Missing for 10: documented ability to reopen or override a closed decision, an audit trail/history of decisions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
